No .cu modifications are needed for this stage.
evidence: model_new.py calls cuda_extension.max_reduce(x, dim=1, keepdim=True) and cuda_extension.relu6(max_values).

The output shape for max_reduce with keepdim=True is input shape with dim set to 1; indices must be torch.int64.
